decisions.reason: The supplement range builds on the firm's established offer, had its own web page, and fits the announced consumer health expansion, so management stays committed despite possible modest results.
The skin and hair supplement got dedicated web presentation and supports the announced consumer health broadening, and weak sales can be blamed on a temporary market conditions such as the pandemic.
Visibility rose from a mention to its own page, a sign of growing commitment to a product that fits the firm's portfolio strategy.
The mushroom-based immune supplement is a more niche item, but post-pandemic interest in immunity and the firm's prior investment favor keeping it.

The 2018 valsartan contamination recall hit the whole industry and can be attributed to an external, temporary cause, and the firm kept listing the product afterward, so it persists with this core generic.
The OTC migraine triptan was a visible, regulatory-intensive investment presented on its own page and is central to the firm's push into consumer health, so it is retained.
